lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of circular, high-luminance blobs are arranged posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains between 4 and 6 discrete spots, forming a roughly rectangular grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity run through the columns of blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes where the circular spots intersect these vertical linear features.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (light) on the upper edge to low-intensity (shadow) on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Three remoras are visible attached to the shark: one positioned above the pectoral fin, one near the lower margin of the gill slits, and one further anterior near the head region.
